title: Memory-Type Null Controllability for Non-Autonomous Degenerate Parabolic Equations with Boundary Degeneracy
summary: This paper studies the memory-type null controllability of a class of one-dimensional non-autonomous degenerate parabolic equations with Volterra-type memory terms. The diffusion operator is considered in both divergence and non-divergence forms and may exhibit weak or strong degeneracy at the boundary, while the diffusion coefficient depends explicitly on time. Due to the presence of memory effects, classical null controllability is insufficient, and a stronger notion requiring the vanishing of both the state and the accumulated memory is introduced.
